reading: A growth-analytics dashboard: a header bar with a title and date-range button, a row of four stat cards (Visitors, Sign-ups, Activated, Paid) each with a number and sparkline, a conversion-funnel chart card, and below it two more cards for a stacked sign-ups-by-source bar chart and a retention cohort heat table — all content and styling specified precisely by the typed notes.
